attributes.action: Fix the potholes and stop enforcing the new 20MPH speed limit in Birmingham
attributes.additional_details: Birmingham council has changed the speed limits from 40mph to 30mph and now to 20. The council at this point is doing this to make more money from drivers.
attributes.background: I want them to stop enforcing the new 20MPH speed limit in Birmingham. Fix the potholes and stop decreasing limits. It’s as simple as it is. We went from 40mph to 30mph and now 20. We might Aswell start travelling on camels and horses

rejection.details:
We can only accept petitions about things the Government or Parliament are directly responsible for.

Decisions about speed limits and road repairs in Birmingham are a matter for Birmingham City Council, not the UK Government or Parliament.

You can find out more here: https://www.birmingham.gov.uk/highways
